en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of the divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of the divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਰਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: aapanaRai hath aarasee aape hee dhekhai|

en.bdb: The mirror (in the form of world) is in the hand (of the Lord) and man sees of himself in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਭੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: aape dhekh dhikhaidhaa chhia dharasan bhekhai|

en.bdb: God visualises and makes men see the guises and  philosophies of six Schools (in this mirror).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਮੂਹ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਲਿਦਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੈ ਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: jehaa mooh kar bhaalidhaa tevehai lekhai|

en.bdb: Man is reflected (in the mirror) in exactly the same way as is his propensity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਦੇ ਹਸਦਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਸੋ ਰੂਪ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: hasadhe hasadhaa dhekheeaai so roop sarekhai|

en.bdb: The laughing person finds a  laughing form in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਦੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਰੋਵਦਾ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: rodhai dhisai rovadhaa hoe nimakh nimekhai|

en.bdb: Whereas the wailing person finds himself (as well as everybody) there in the weeping posture. Same is the case of a clever person.
The Lord Himself is prevading this world-mirror but He is specifically preceivable in and through the holy congregation.
